units: <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 5:10">Tosef. Dem. V, 10</cite> <he>ניטל מכל ק׳ וק׳</he> he takes tithe from each bunch of cucumbers.
<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 3:1">Ter. III, 1</cite> <he>התורם ק׳ ונמצאת וכ׳</he> if one separates a cucumber for T’rumah, and it is found to be bitter.
Tosef. ib. IV, 5 אין לך מר בק׳ וכ׳ there is nothing bitter in the cucumber except the central part (the central cucumber in the bunch (?)); a. e.—Pl. (v. supra).
<cite ref="Shabbat 109a">Sabb. 109ᵃ</cite> Ar. s. v. <cite ref="I00741"><he>טרז</he></cite>; v. <cite ref="K01302"><he>כָּשׁוּת</he></cite>.—V. <cite ref="S02223"><he>קִשּׁוּאִים</he></cite>.
